criteria.text: The response identifies that the Supply Agreement renews automatically for successive 3-year Renewal Terms unless a party gives non-renewal notice at least 180 days before the then-current term expires. It states that, measured from the Initial Term's end in February 2028, the notice deadline falls in early September 2027 (September 2, 2027). It cites Supply Agreement Section 2.2, explains why this matters to Breimourt, and recommends a fix.

The response identifies that the exclusivity in Supply Agreement Section 4.1 is worldwide, covers content in all media and binds Breimourt's Affiliates. It states that the Order Form's United States and Canada Territory does not narrow that exclusivity. It cites Supply Agreement Section 4.1, explains why this matters to Breimourt, and recommends a fix.

The response identifies that Order Form Section 1.1 defines 'Covered Services' as physical DCP duplication and hard-drive shipment only, which is narrower than Supply Agreement Section 1.4. It states that this narrower definition governs the US$850,000 Minimum Annual Commitment, so mastering, KDM and/or electronic delivery fees do not count toward the minimum. It explains why this matters to Breimourt and recommends a fix.
hints: physical DCP duplication and hard-drive shipment only
do not count toward the minimum

criteria.text: The response identifies that the Order Form Section 3.4 option to reduce the Minimum Annual Commitment had to be exercised by January 15, 2026, which is 45 days before the second Contract Year began on March 1, 2026. It states that Breimourt's February 2, 2026 notice was late. It explains why this matters to Breimourt and recommends a fix.

The response identifies that Parent Guaranty Section 12 selects Ontario law and the exclusive jurisdiction of the Ontario Superior Court of Justice. It states that this conflicts with the Supply Agreement's New York law and exclusive New York County forum. It explains why this matters to Breimourt and recommends a fix.
The response states that the Initial Term is three years from March 1, 2025, ending in February 2028.
The response states that the Minimum Annual Commitment is US$850,000 per Contract Year.

The response is structured as a memo addressed to the supervising partner. It presents the issues in a ranked order with the most significant first, and for each issue it gives a location, why it matters, and a recommended fix.
The response claims that Breimourt's February 2, 2026 notice reducing the Minimum Annual Commitment was timely.
The response claims that the Order Form's Territory limits Breimourt's exclusivity obligation to the United States and Canada.
hints: exclusivity limited to United States and Canada
